text:
anna (infra): heads-up, spotted a weird parity gap between staging and prod in us-west2. nodes in the "shadow" pool still report gpu=true label but the gpu taint (nvidia.com/gpu=present:NoSchedule) is missing. GitOps didn't reapply it after last sync. anyone seen this?
sam (platform): :eyes: seeing the same in the env-parity dashboard. alert triggered by parity-checker at 08:12 UTC. looks like the helm values for node-taints were empty in the last release for that chart. flux shows a sync but helm hook failed then retried and considered healthy.
jordan (sre): quick check commands i ran:```bash
# list nodes in shadow pool with taint/labels
kubectl get nodes -l pool=shadow -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,TAINTS:.spec.taints,LAB:.metadata.labels.gpu
```results show label present but taint null on 6 nodes. pods using gpux-scheduler are still running (they were scheduled earlier), but new pods won't land.
maria (eng): that matches an issue we saw when a previous chart bump removed taint template. terraform state for nodepools didn't change. suspect Helm chart templating bug that rendered an empty list for taints when feature flag OFF.
sam (platform): cause path summary: terraform created nodepool -> node labels set via cloud-init -> helm chart expected to add taint via a post-install hook, hook failed to run so taint never applied -> GitOps marked sync complete because resources existed -> parity checker only compares desired taint vs actual and alerted.
anna (infra): typo: Anna -> anna (infra). proposal options: 1) immediate remediation: run a non-disruptive daemonset to add taints via kubectl patch on affected nodes (low blast); 2) safer: update helm values + force a flux/argocd reconcile that re-runs the hook (but hooks sometimes skip on no-change); 3) infra long-term: add a pre-flight policy check to the GitOps pipeline to block chart merges that clear taints.
jordan (sre): i'm worried about option 1 causing scheduling churn. if we patch taints, any running gpu pods that tolerate the taint might be fine, but others could be evicted. we should verify tolerations first:```bash
kubectl get pods -A -o json | jq '.items[] | select(.spec.tolerations != null) | {ns: .metadata.namespace, name: .metadata.name, tols: .spec.tolerations}' | grep "nvidia.com/gpu"
```
sam (platform): can we do a dry run with a single node? i'll cordon one node, drain non-gpu pods, patch taint, then uncordon. if everything good, scale plan to remaining nodes.
maria (eng): created a draft PR to ensure helm templates render taints even when feature_flag=false: https://github.com/redwood/charts/pull/1021 - includes a unit test for template output.
anna (infra): nice. i'll open an ops PR to run a one-off remediation job: https://github.com/redwood/ops/pull/789 - job will: detect affected nodes, run `kubectl patch` to add taint, and annotate nodes with `repair/redwood=2026-03-20`. it's idempotent.
jordan (sre): instructions for dry-run step for whoever executes:```bash
NODE=k8s-shadow-07
kubectl cordon $NODE
# move non-gpu pods off
kubectl drain $NODE --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --pod-selector='!gpu-pod'
kubectl patch node $NODE -p '{"spec":{"taints":[{"key":"nvidia.com/gpu","value":"present","effect":"NoSchedule"}]}}'
kubectl uncordon $NODE
```we'll monitor rollouts for 15m.
sam (platform): i'll take the dry-run in 20m and post results. if good, we run across the 6 nodes in 3 batches.
infra-bot: automated parity-checker note: 6 nodes flagged in us-west2.shadowpool between 08:12-08:16 UTC. incident id: par-20260320-12.
maria (eng): PR 1021 includes helm unit tests but we still need a pipeline gate. i'd like to add an opa/gate check that rejects chart renders that remove required taints. filing a follow-up ticket.
anna (infra): action items: sam do dry-run, if green run remediation job PR 789 (ops) with 3-batch window; maria merge chart fix and add pipeline gate; jordan watch scheduling + evictions; i'll follow-up with a postmortem note and update the parity alerts to include the helm-hook exit code.
sam (platform): dry-run complete: cordon->drain->patch on k8s-shadow-07 worked, no unexpected evictions. patch command and node annotation applied. proceeding with batch 1 for two nodes now.
jordan (sre): monitoring: no new evictions, pods rescheduled fine. cpu spike ~6% during drains only.
anna (infra): thanks team. will mark incident closed after all nodes patched and chart fix merged. recorded link to runbook snippet: https://internal.redwood.dev/runbooks/node-taint-repair
